wall_timing_boundary: synchronize before timer; start-event record, K calls, end-event record/synchronization inside wall timer

K_selection.update: ceil(K * 20 / observed_block_ms), clamp 1..10000; stop within [15,30], unchanged K, or fourth observed block
K_selection.selection: K from final observed block; no fastest observation selection

api_allocation_boundary: both methods construct complete plan/workspace plus roundtrip each call
gpu_timing_interpretation: CUDA event interval includes eager launch gaps, checked synchronization and allocator gaps; not kernel duration sum
measurement_pairing: Same case/session/block_id; each method normalized by its own frozen K
timing_residency: Both implementations and their identical-input tensors resident during paired timing
